from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        shared = operator.SharedMemory(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            num_rounds=2,
            worker_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.GRID_SHARED_WORKER_PROMPT_A,
                prompt_custom.GRID_SHARED_WORKER_PROMPT_B,
                prompt_custom.GRID_SHARED_WORKER_PROMPT_C,
            ],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.GRID_SHARED_AGG_PROMPT,
        )
        draft = await shared(problem)
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.GRID_FINAL_CHECK_PROMPT_A, prompt_custom.GRID_FINAL_CHECK_PROMPT_B, prompt_custom.GRID_FINAL_CHECK_PROMPT_C], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.GRID_FINAL_STAR_AGG_PROMPT)
        checked = await star(problem + "\n\nDraft candidate:\n" + draft["response"])
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=1, prompts=[prompt_custom.GRID_FINAL_FORMAT_PROMPT])
        solution = await seq(problem + "\n\nConsensus candidate:\n" + checked["response"])
        worker_usage = self.llm.get_usage_delta()
        if self.aggregator_llm is self.llm:
            aggregator_usage = {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0}
        else:
            aggregator_usage = self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta()
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": worker_usage,
            "aggregator": aggregator_usage,
        }
